tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /bka' 'dus sgrub chen bzlas pa'i skabs su dzab¿ bskul rgyas par spro na/ gtso bo la/ hūm̐: ye shes gzhal yas rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor na: rigs kun bdag po spyi dpal he ru ka: gnyis med yum 'khyud rig mdangs sprul pa'i 'khor: drug brgya re drug rdzogs pa'i lha tshogs rnams: sku ni dur khrod chas rnams rdzogs: gsung ni sgra sgrogs sngags kyi sgra: thugs ni sgrol mdzad srog dang bcas: dzab¿ kyis rgyud bskul sku gsung thugs: phaṭa kyis spros pas stong gsum gang : ma gsal bar du bskyed cing bsgom: ma grub bar du mi btang ngo : zhes dang*/ 'khor rnams la/ hūm̐: shar stod byams pa chen po'i dkyil 'khor na: khyab brdal ye shes yang dag he ru ka: dbyings phyug yum 'khyud rig mdangs sprul pa'i 'khor: drug cu rtsa brgyad rdzogs pa'i lha tshogs rnams: sku ni dur khrod sogs/ hūm̐: shar srib snying rje chen po'i dkyil 'khor na: stobs ldan ye shes rdo rje phreng ba che: snang dbyings yum 'khyud rig mdangs sprul pa'i 'khor: brgya dang rtsa brgyad rdzogs pa'i lha tshogs rnams: sku ni dur khrod sogs/ hūm̐: shar dbus dga' ba'i dkyil 'khor chen po na: 'bar ba'i ye shes dpal chen gsang ba'i bdag: dbang sdud yum 'khyud rig mdangs sprul pa'i 'khor: rnam grangs brgyad cu rdzogs pa'i lha tshogs rnams: sku ni dur khrod sogs/ hūm̐: shar smad btang snyoms chen po'i dkyil 'khor na: yid bzhin ye shes rdo rje rtsal chen rdzogs: bde ma yum 'khyud rig mdangs sprul pa'i 'khor: sum cu rtsa drug rdzogs pa'i lha tshogs rnams: sku ni dur khrod sogs: hūm̐: lho stod sbyin pa chen po'i dkyil 'khor na: chags bral ye shes rdo rje thod phreng rtsal: sbyor ba'i yum 'khyud rig mdangs sprul pa'i 'khor: mkha' 'gro brgyad cu rdzogs pa'i lha tshogs rnams: sku ni dur khrod sogs/ hūm̐: lho srib ngag snyan smra ba'i dkyil 'khor na:

bde chen ye shes 'khor lo bde ba'i mchog: rnal 'byor mas 'khyud rig mdangs sprul pa'i 'khor: drug cu rtsa gnyis rdzogs pa'i lha tshogs rnams: sku ni dur khrod sogs/ hūm̐: lho dbus don mthun rol pa'i dkyil 'khor na: gtum rngams ye shes bcom ldan gshin rje'i gshed: za byed yum 'khyud rig mdangs= drug cu rtsa lnga rdzogs pa'i lha tshogs rnams: sku ni dur khrod sogs/ hūm̐: lho smad don spyod rol pa'i dkyil 'khor na: bsam 'phel ye shes kun 'byung ratna rtsal: sbyor ba'i yum 'khyud rig= lnga bcu rtsa lnga rdzogs pa'i lha tshogs= sku ni dur khrod sogs/ hūm̐: nub stod 'dod pa zag med dkyil 'khor na: sor rtog ye shes padma rta mgrin rgyal: ral gcig yum 'khyud rig mdangs= lnga bcu rtsa lnga rdzogs pa'i lha tshogs rnams: sku ni dur khrod sogs/ hūm̐: nub srib ma rig zag med dkyil 'khor na: dga' chen ye shes dgyes pa'i rdo rje bzhad: bdag med yum 'khyud rig mdangs= drug cu rtsa lnga rdzogs pa'i= sku ni dur khrod sogs/ hūm̐: nub dkyil sred pa zag med dkyil 'khor na: 'od gsal ye shes bde gshegs gsang ba 'dus: mkha' spyod yum khyud rig= brgya dang sum cu rdzogs pa'i= sku ni sogs/ hūm̐: nub smad lta ba zag med dkyil 'khor na: rnam dag ye shes padma rtsal chen po: 'od skor yum 'khyud rig mdangs= dgu bcu rtsa brgyad rdzogs pa'i lha tshogs rnams: sku ni dur khrod sogs/ hūm̐: byang stod chos kun stong nyid dkyil 'khor na: zung 'jug ye shes khrag 'thung che ba'i mchog: dbyings phyug yum 'khyud rig= bdun cu rtsa gnyis rdzogs= sku ni dur khrod sogs/ hūm̐: byang srib mtshan ma med pa'i dkyil 'khor na: rtog bral ye shes dus kyi 'khor lo dpal: dzñā na yum 'khyud rig mdangs= brgya dang re bzhi rdzogs pa'i lha tshogs= sku ni dur khrod sogs/ hūm̐: byang dkyil smon pa med pa'i dkyil 'khor na:

'dod 'byung ye shes zag med mkha' klong 'khyil: u tsuṣmar 'khyud rig= brgya dang bcu bdun rdzogs pa'i= sku ni dur khrod sogs/ hūm̐: byang smad 'du mi byed pa'i dkyil 'khor naḥ shugs 'chang ye shes thogs med karma rtsal: zil gnon yum 'khyud rig mdangs= brgya dang lnga bcu rdzogs pa'i lha tshogs rnams: sku ni dur khrod sogs/ hūm̐: shar lho lus dran nyer gzhag dkyil 'khor na: thig le ye shes bla med mngon rdzogs rgyal: nyid zhi yum 'khyud rig= bdun cu rtsa bzhi rdzogs pa'i= sku ni dur khrod sogs/ hūm̐: lho nub tshor dran nyer gzhag dkyil 'khor na: bdud 'joms ye shes badzra kī la ya: rgyas 'debs yum 'khyud rig= brgyad cu rtsa bzhi rdzogs pa'i lha tshogs rnams: sku ni dur khrod sogs/ hūm̐: nub byang sems dran nyer gzhag dkyil 'khor na: bgegs 'dul ye shes dregs pa thams cad 'dul: spyi 'dul yum 'khyud rig mdangs= dregs pa bzhi bcu rdzogs pa'i lha tshogs rnams: sku ni dur khrod sogs/ hūm̐: byang shar chos dran nyer gzhag dkyil 'khor na: mngon spyod ye shes dpal chen stobs ldan nag: 'byung lnga'i bdag 'khyud rig mdangs= nyi shu rtsa brgyad rdzogs pa'i lha tshogs rnams: sku ni dur khrod sogs/ khro bo spyi dril la/ hūm̐: tshom bu nyer gcig 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor na: ye shes nyer gcig kun tu ma 'dres mdangs: dpal chen nyer gcig bka' 'dus lha tshogs rnams: sku ni sogs/ zhes sbyar la so so'i bzlas pa bya zhing*/ mthar re re bzhin stong tshigs kyi mchod pa'ang bya'o/ /zhes pa'ang badzra dzñā nas so// //
